claims: Colman Domingo is hosting Saturday Night Live on April 11, 2026.
Colman Domingo's hosting of Saturday Night Live on April 11, 2026 marks his first time hosting the show.
Anitta serves as the musical guest on Saturday Night Live on April 11, 2026.
Anitta's appearance on Saturday Night Live on April 11, 2026 marks her debut on SNL.
The Saturday Night Live episode on April 11, 2026 airs live on NBC at 11:30 p.m. EST.
The Saturday Night Live episode on April 11, 2026 is available to stream on Peacock.
There is a 22-second promo for the Saturday Night Live episode with Colman Domingo and Anitta on YouTube by Saturday Night Live dated April 9, 2026.
Saturday Night Live will take a break next week.
Saturday Night Live will return for the end of Season 51.
